dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep, this place is as freezing as ever... *whimper* Paimon's hands are turning to ice...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Want to climb into my hood?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You sure? Is it warm in there?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It should take the edge off, and it might improve your mood. But I recommend finding a heat source for a more potent effect.
